snippet.title: Quite Bloom trailer 2026
snippet.description: Quiet Bloom is a cozy idle game. Awaken the wind, dig wells, and call the rain to tend your land for you. Gather wood, stone, and water, raise wind vanes and solar panels, and watch a cracked desert slowly bloom into a luxuriant green oasis.
